description: T1.9a: DDGI GPU cost against batch size (32 to 4,096 probes) through the three adapter, the 2 ms budget held at a viewer-like frame rate, and start-up times (load, compile, trees, first GI, settled). VITE_DDGI_SCENES=a,b picks scenes (default cornell-box,two-room); VITE_DDGI_SECTIONS=startup,budget,curve,steady,breakdown picks parts (default the first three). Sponza and Bistro need the downloads. For hand use under the bench lock.
